rationale: Session HITL approval is recorded without approver identity for the fresh R5 read-only final review. It owns no writable files and reviews the frozen QA, source, schema, policy, dependency, and documentation evidence for a terminal safety/compatibility verdict. No implementation, test mutation, external AGY retry, deploy, publish, push, credential, secret, account, or raw-stream action is authorized. A later AGY R3 smoke remains separately pending and needs its own fresh decision and scheduling snapshot only after this review passes.
